violated_contract: A harness that advances virtual time and then observes durable filesystem state must not declare quiescence from in-memory coordinator-idle or an event-queue drain while a timer callback it fired still has an unawaited Future performing the write. CaptureReplayWorld.settle() returned when RecordingTransferCoordinator.hasInFlight was false; LocalWalSync's async periodic flush Future was discarded by ManualScheduler, so process-kill reconstruction could reload empty WALs even though writeAsBytes completed milliseconds later.
canonical_prevention: ManualScheduler tracks the Future returned by each fired timer callback and exposes waitForCallbackIo. CaptureReplayWorld.settle and dispose await that Future set in addition to coordinator idle, with no wall-clock sleep. A unit test parks an async periodic callback on a Completer across elapse and asserts hasInFlightIo until waitForCallbackIo.
